row: Located in San Diego, the staff at Center Veterinary Clinic are committed to your pet's health. Center Veterinary Clinic based in San Diego, excels in the science of Veterinary medicine and has been established for over 30 years. Dr. Matt Bigelow and our staff provide compassionate and complete veterinary care in the San Diego area.
